scope: Original-art visual review of Cargo patch/composite/static placement only; helper/code and runtime selection pending.
observedReasons: The two dark features remain separate irregular patches in the original upper-right and middle-right portions. They are not resolved into repeated slots, stud heads or an open cup/neck.

The dominant tan/brown mass keeps its source arrangement and softly varied illumination. Surface detail is restrained at delivered4x scale; there is no new lid, lattice construction, bright long rim or named material mechanism.

The distinct irregular pale lower feature is retained above the darker support. In the all-layer static placement it preserves the light/shape transition beside the adjoining curved gold form rather than flattening both into a brown block.

The final composite has no visible component-transfer splice at the fitting boundary. The reviewed fine crossing mesh and all pixels outside the source patch remain exact to the previously reviewed repaired base.
